description:
Zoey's Faction Customization

Requires Patchlib as well as MagicLib, LazyLib and LunaLib!

Works great with Illustrated Entities!

Adds a few ways to customize your faction!

Features:
Change your faction color!
Change your fleet names!
Change your post/rank names!
Change your faction description!
Change your illegal/legal commodities, with mechanical effects! (Effects can be disabled in lunalib.)

Faction description is accessed through your faction panel - all else is in bespoke intel pages within your faction intel category.

Compatibility
Can be added to existing saves, but not removed.
FAQ
This modded commodity doesn't appear in the list!
Pester the mod author to add a commodity entry to their copy of data>campaign>ZFCCommoditySpecs.csv, not me!
The only thing that appears in intel is my faction color!
That's because you don't have your faction established yet. Most of the intel only appears if you have at least one colony.
This UI isn't impressive!
I'm not a UI modder. It's... a weak point.
Was AI used in the creation of this mod?
Only Intellij's simple autocomplete function, which is barely AI powered to begin with.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Zoey-s-Faction-Customization/releases
Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/Zoey-s-Faction-Customization
Changelog1.0.0

Initial

Hey, what's with the name?Turns out I'm a girl. My mods will remain niko until I decide to change them to my new name.
And no, this still isn't my IRL name :wink:

Modder informationIf you want to add your special commodity to my commodity list, find data>campaign>ZFCCommoditySpecs.csv in my mod and copy it to yours. Create a new IllegalCommodityPlugin implementation (a rather simple class), and determine the category - STANDARD, TABOO, AI, or MISC.

discordPostHtml:
Adds a few ways to customize your faction beyond just name!

Requires Patchlib.

Modules

  1. Commodities - Most commodities can now be toggled between legal and illegal. Changing from the default has mechanical implications for all of your colonies.
  2. Fleet names
  3. Post/Rank titles
  4. Faction color
  5. Faction description

Cannot be removed from existing saves, but can be added.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Zoey-s-Faction-Customization/releases
Forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36193.0

AI Disclaimer - No AI was used in the creation of this mod.
aiDescription: Allows players to change their faction color, fleet names, post/rank names, and faction description. It also lets you modify illegal and legal commodities with mechanical effects that can be disabled via LunaLib. These options are accessed through the faction panel or bespoke intel pages.
